test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the software launched by the National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (NMDFC) for digitising loan accounting processes and integrating the MIS portal, including the release of mobile apps for Android and IOS?

options.text: MILAP (Minority Loan Accounting Software for Projects)

solution:
The correct answer is __**MILAN (Minority Loan Accounting for NMDFC)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (NMDFC) launched the software named MILAN for digitising loan accounting processes.
 
• MILAN stands for Minority Loan Accounting for NMDFC, aimed at simplifying loan disbursement and tracking for minority communities.
 
• The software integrates the Management Information System (MIS) portal, ensuring seamless operation and transparency.
 
• The initiative includes the release of mobile apps compatible with both Android and IOS platforms, enhancing accessibility.
 
• It aims to improve operational efficiency, accountability, and ease of access for minority beneficiaries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (NMDFC)**

 
 
• NMDFC is a government body under the Ministry of Minority Affairs, aimed at promoting economic and developmental activities for the benefit of backward sections of notified minorities.
 
• The corporation provides concessional finance for self-employment and income-generating activities to eligible beneficiaries.
 
 
 
• **Loan Accounting Software**
 
 
• Loan accounting software is designed to manage and streamline the processes associated with loan disbursement, repayment, and tracking.
 
• Such software ensures accuracy, reduces manual errors, and enhances the efficiency of financial operations.
 
 
 
• **Management Information System (MIS)**
 
 
• MIS is a computerized database that tracks and manages data, providing essential information for decision-making and operational efficiency.
 
• It helps organizations monitor performance, manage projects, and streamline processes.
 
 
 
• **Mobile App Integration**
 
 
• Mobile app integration refers to the process of connecting a mobile application with other systems, software, or hardware to ensure seamless functionality and user experience.
 
• This allows users to access services and information on the go, enhancing convenience and accessibility.
